Container.Name: nexora
Container.Overview: Nexora, a self-hosted wiki with nested pages, backlinks and a knowledge graph. Full text search, versions, comments and attachments; import from Obsidian, Notion and Confluence. This is the web interface; it needs the nexora-backend container in the same Docker network. The first account that registers becomes the administrator.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Port for the interface over HTTP.

Config.Name: Web interface (TLS)
Config.Description: The same interface, encrypted with a certificate the container issues itself.

Config.Name: Service scheme
Config.Description: How the interface reaches the backend. http, because this setup has no certificate authority of its own.

Config.Name: Service port
Config.Description: The backend's port inside the network.

Config.Name: Certificate name
Config.Description: Name written into the self-issued certificate.

Config.Name: Certificate
Config.Description: Keeps the self-issued certificate across updates.
